judge_note: Re-judged 2026-07-24 with judge=groq:openai/gpt-oss-120b (previous judge was local GGUF DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B). Also fixed a pre-existing eval/judge.py bug: judge_pairs() stored judge_pair()'s GENERIC position-label winner ('A'/'B' = first/second argument) directly as the per-prompt winner instead of remapping to the real condition code. This is a no-op for A-vs-B (right happens to literally be 'B') but silently mis-tallied every A-vs-{C,D,E,F} run: a real right-side win (raw label 'B') never matched the real right code ('E' etc.) in _summarize_pair's `winner == right` check, so it fell into the 'tie' bucket instead of 'loss'. Confirmed on this run's raw pre-fix data: A_vs_E per-prompt winners were literally 'B' 4/6 times (E won) but the old tally reported 6/6 ties. Fixed in eval/judge.py judge_pairs(); score_from_verdicts() (the --pack/hand-judging path) was already correct and unaffected.
